entries.recorded_title: Improved Learning-Augmented Algorithms and (Tight) Lower Bounds for Multi-Option Ski Rental Problem
entries.difference: gives tight lower bounds for learning-augmented problems; we report a measured boundary with a per-seed interval rather than a bound.

entries.title: Online Graph Algorithms with Predictions
entries.recorded_title: Online Graph Algorithms with Predictions
entries.venue: Proceedings of the 2022 Annual ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms (SODA)
entries.difference: carries predictions into online graph problems; our stream is an agent's own calls, whose order we also generate.

entries.title: Discrete-Smoothness in Online Algorithms with Predictions
entries.recorded_title: Discrete-Smoothness in Online Algorithms with Predictions
entries.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
entries.difference: introduces discrete smoothness for prediction-augmented algorithms; we use a two-point tail pair rather than a smoothness parameter.

entries.title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
entries.recorded_title: Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions
entries.difference: predicts output length with uncertainty for LLM scheduling; our instrument's predicted quantity is the call's duration, known exactly.

entries.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
entries.recorded_title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
entries.difference: schedules LLM inference using tail-aware prediction; we ask what that prediction buys when the pool, not the queue, is binding.

entries.title: CARB: A Characterization-Guided Framework for CNN Inference Cost Prediction and Deployment Screening
entries.recorded_title: CARB: A Characterization-Guided Framework for CNN Inference Cost Prediction and Deployment Screening
entries.difference: predicts inference cost from characterisation; cost prediction is the input our instrument assumes exact.

entries.title: Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving
entries.recorded_title: Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving
entries.difference: measures learned request routing after calibration; we show routing and early issue are different uses of the same prediction.

entries.title: A new performance metric for the ski rental problem
entries.recorded_title: A new performance metric for the ski rental problem
entries.difference: proposes a new metric for ski rental; our metric is a boundary in measured contention with a confidence interval.

entries.title: Use Equal-Work or Equal-Time Speedup, Not Geomean Speedup
entries.recorded_title: Use Equal-Work or Equal-Time Speedup, Not Geomean Speedup
entries.venue: 2025 IEEE International Symposium on Performance Analysis of Systems and Software (ISPASS)
entries.difference: argues geomean speedup misstates parallel gains; our headline is a ratio against the serial schedule of the same work.

entries.title: R.I.P. Geomean Speedup Use Equal-Work (Or Equal-Time) Harmonic Mean Speedup Instead
entries.recorded_title: R.I.P. Geomean Speedup Use Equal-Work (Or Equal-Time) Harmonic Mean Speedup Instead
entries.venue: 2025 IEEE International Symposium on High Performance Computer Architecture (HPCA)
entries.difference: shows geomean speedup is not a valid aggregate; we report per-cell intervals instead of an aggregate over cells.

entries.title: A note on superlinear speedup
entries.recorded_title: A note on superlinear speedup
entries.difference: explains when speedups exceed the processor count; we show a series of speedups all bought by the same parallelism.

entries.title: Unconventional Wisdom: Superlinear Speedup and Inherently Parallel Computations
entries.recorded_title: Unconventional Wisdom: Superlinear Speedup and Inherently Parallel Computations
entries.difference: explains superlinear speedup by search-space effects; our speedups come from overlapping waits, which is a different source.

entries.title: Computer Architecture and Amdahl's Law
entries.recorded_title: Computer Architecture and Amdahl's Law
entries.difference: re-reads Amdahl's law for modern architectures; our serial baseline is exactly the reference it requires.

entries.title: On Extending Amdahl's law to Learn Computer Performance
entries.recorded_title: On Extending Amdahl's law to Learn Computer Performance
entries.difference: extends Amdahl's law to learned performance models; we measure where the parallel fraction stops buying anything.

entries.title: How Amdahl's low restricts supercomputer applications and building ever bigger supercomputers
entries.recorded_title: How Amdahl's low restricts supercomputer applications and building ever bigger supercomputers
entries.difference: uses Amdahl's law to bound supercomputer applications; the same bound applies when the baseline is one agent's serial loop.

entries.title: The Effect of Temperature on Amdahl Law in 3D Multicore Era
entries.recorded_title: The Effect of Temperature on Amdahl Law in 3D Multicore Era
entries.difference: studies an environmental modifier of Amdahl's law; our modifier is contention rather than temperature, and it is measured.

entries.title: Parallel test description and analysis of parallel test system speedup through Amdahl&#x0027;s law
entries.recorded_title: Parallel test description and analysis of parallel test system speedup through Amdahl&#x0027;s law
entries.difference: analyses speedup for a parallel test system; its baseline is a dedicated machine rather than an agent's serial schedule.

entries.title: Integrating Amdahl-like Laws and Divisible Load Theory
entries.recorded_title: Integrating Amdahl-like Laws and Divisible Load Theory
entries.difference: integrates fixed-size and scaled speedup views; our boundary is in contention, not in problem size.

entries.title: Modernizing Amdahl's Law: How AI Scaling Laws Shape Computer Architecture
entries.recorded_title: Modernizing Amdahl's Law: How AI Scaling Laws Shape Computer Architecture
entries.difference: modernises Amdahl's law for AI scaling laws; our point is that part of a reported speculation gain was never serial work.

entries.title: Scaling LLM Inference Beyond Amdahl`s Limits via Eliminating Non-Scalable Overheads
entries.recorded_title: Scaling LLM Inference Beyond Amdahl`s Limits via Eliminating Non-Scalable Overheads
entries.difference: seeks speedups beyond Amdahl's limit by removing non-scalable work; we quantify how much of a reported speedup was already available.

entries.title: Fixed-Size Speedup
entries.recorded_title: Fixed-Size Speedup
entries.difference: defines fixed-size speedup as a metric; our ratio is taken at fixed work, which is that definition.

entries.title: Another view on parallel speedup
entries.recorded_title: Another view on parallel speedup
entries.difference: re-examines how parallel speedup should be measured; we adopt a paired per-seed ratio over the serial schedule.

entries.title: A DLT-Aware Performance Evaluation Framework for Virtual-Core Speedup Modeling
entries.recorded_title: A DLT-Aware Performance Evaluation Framework for Virtual-Core Speedup Modeling
entries.difference: builds a performance-evaluation framework for virtual-core speedup; we use a deterministic simulator with ground truth by construction.

entries.title: Using Sequential Runtime Distributions for the Parallel Speedup Prediction of SAT Local Search
entries.recorded_title: Using Sequential Runtime Distributions for the Parallel Speedup Prediction of SAT Local Search
entries.difference: predicts parallel speedup from sequential runtime distributions; we predict a crossover from a measured contention coordinate.

entries.title: A Model for Speedup of Parallel Programs
entries.recorded_title: A Model for Speedup of Parallel Programs
entries.difference: models parallel speedup from program structure; our structure is a think phase and a call phase sharing a pool.

entries.title: Scheduling parallel jobs with linear speedup
entries.recorded_title: Scheduling parallel jobs with linear speedup
entries.difference: schedules parallel jobs that speed up linearly; our jobs are single-threaded and the linear part comes from issuing them early.

entries.title: Improved Online Scheduling of Moldable Task Graphs under Common Speedup Models
entries.recorded_title: Improved Online Scheduling of Moldable Task Graphs under Common Speedup Models
entries.difference: schedules moldable task graphs online under a speedup function; our width is fixed per run and the schedule is what varies.

entries.title: Multi-level projection with exponential parallel speedup; Application to sparse auto-encoders neural networks
entries.recorded_title: Multi-level projection with exponential parallel speedup; Application to sparse auto-encoders neural networks
entries.difference: reports exponential parallel speedup for a projection method; it is the kind of isolated speedup claim our serial baseline re-prices.

entries.title: Blockwise Stochastic Variance-Reduced Methods with Parallel Speedup for Multi-Block Bilevel Optimization
entries.recorded_title: Blockwise Stochastic Variance-Reduced Methods with Parallel Speedup for Multi-Block Bilevel Optimization
entries.difference: reports parallel speedup for a variance-reduced optimiser; its parallelism is a numerical property, ours is an issue policy.

entries.title: Workload characterization of interactive cloud services on big and small server platforms
entries.recorded_title: Workload characterization of interactive cloud services on big and small server platforms
entries.venue: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Workload Characterization (IISWC)
entries.difference: characterises interactive cloud workloads on two machine sizes; our workload is generated so its properties are known by construction.

entries.title: Locality Exists in Graph Processing: Workload Characterization on an Ivy Bridge Server
entries.recorded_title: Locality Exists in Graph Processing: Workload Characterization on an Ivy Bridge Server
entries.venue: 2015 IEEE International Symposium on Workload Characterization
entries.difference: characterises graph-processing locality on a real machine; we run no real workload, which is why our ground truth is by construction.

entries.title: Towards Cloud Efficiency with Large-scale Workload Characterization
entries.recorded_title: Towards Cloud Efficiency with Large-scale Workload Characterization
entries.difference: characterises cloud workloads at scale to improve efficiency; our contention is an instrument coordinate, not a production measurement.

entries.title: ServeGen: Workload Characterization and Generation of Large Language Model Serving in Production
entries.recorded_title: ServeGen: Workload Characterization and Generation of Large Language Model Serving in Production
entries.difference: characterises and generates LLM serving workloads; our workload is a synthetic agent loop whose parameters are all declared.

entries.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels
entries.recorded_title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels
entries.difference: characterises LLM inference phases across devices; our two phases, think and tool, are separated so the speculation can be priced.

entries.title: CARM Tool: Cache-Aware Roofline Model Automatic Benchmarking and Application Analysis
entries.recorded_title: CARM Tool: Cache-Aware Roofline Model Automatic Benchmarking and Application Analysis
entries.difference: automates roofline benchmarking; our instrument reports its own resolution rather than a peak.

entries.title: Vector-Processing for Mobile Devices: Benchmark and Analysis
entries.recorded_title: Vector-Processing for Mobile Devices: Benchmark and Analysis
entries.difference: benchmarks vector processing on mobile devices; our claim is about a mechanism's boundary rather than one platform's throughput.

entries.title: Efficient Workload Distribution for Sustainable Server Utilization in Cloud Data Centers
entries.recorded_title: Efficient Workload Distribution for Sustainable Server Utilization in Cloud Data Centers
entries.venue: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Systems for Cybersecurity (ISCS)
entries.difference: distributes workload for sustainable server utilisation; our utilisation is derived from busy time and makespan, not assumed.

entries.title: From Fork-Join to Asynchronous Tasks: Parallelizing Tiled Cholesky Decomposition with OpenMP and HPX
entries.recorded_title: From Fork-Join to Asynchronous Tasks: Parallelizing Tiled Cholesky Decomposition with OpenMP and HPX
entries.difference: parallelises a tiled decomposition from fork-join to asynchronous tasks; our structure is one agent with an early-issued call.

entries.title: How to Do Statistical Evaluations in ECE/CS Papers: A Practical Playbook for Defensible Results
entries.recorded_title: How to Do Statistical Evaluations in ECE/CS Papers: A Practical Playbook for Defensible Results
entries.difference: gives a practical playbook for statistical evaluation; we follow it with per-seed intervals and a declared pairing rule.
